description: This Java source file defines the class 'RabbitMQPublisherActor', which is responsible for publishing ExternalMessage objects to RabbitMQ exchanges as part of a messaging connectivity service. It manages message publishing, confirms, callbacks on acknowledgments, and exchange declaration, integrating with the Akka actor framework for concurrency control.

classes.name: ChannelStatus
classes.description: Helper class encapsulating channel confirmation status and target resource statuses.

classes.name: ActorConfirmListener
classes.description: Listener implementation handling RabbitMQ confirms and return messages, updating outstanding acknowledgments accordingly.

classes.name: OutstandingAck
classes.description: Represents an outstanding message acknowledgment, with methods to handle acknowledgment success, failure, and returned messages.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props configuration for instantiating the RabbitMQPublisherActor.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines whether a given acknowledgment should be published, filtering out diagnostic acknowledgments.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Sets up message handlers before the main receive block, particularly handling channel creation and status.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Placeholder for post-initialization configuration, no operation in this implementation.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into a RabbitMQTarget object representing the publish target.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes an ExternalMessage to RabbitMQ, setting properties, handling confirmation modes, and tracking outstanding acknowledges.

methods.name: computeNextPublishSeqNoConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer that tracks the next publish sequence number and registers outstanding acknowledgments based on confirmation mode.

methods.name: addOutstandingAck
methods.description: Adds a new outstanding acknowledgment entry for a published message to track its confirmation status.

methods.name: handleChannelStatus
methods.description: Handles updates to the channel's confirmation status and resource statuses.

methods.name: onChannelCreated
methods.description: Handles initialization tasks after a new RabbitMQ channel is created, such as entering confirmation mode and declaring exchanges.

methods.name: getTimeoutAck
methods.description: Creates an acknowledgment representing a timeout for message confirmation.

methods.name: getUnsupportedAck
methods.description: Creates an acknowledgment indicating that publisher confirms are unsupported.

methods.name: getSuccessAck
methods.description: Creates an acknowledgment indicating successful message publishing.

methods.name: buildAcknowledgement
methods.description: Constructs an Acknowledgement object with specified status and message, including connection ID placeholders.

methods.name: declareExchangesPassive
methods.description: Passively declares exchanges associated with the connection's targets to verify their existence.

methods.name: tryToEnterConfirmationMode
methods.description: Attempts to put a channel into confirm mode, handling exceptions.

methods.name: enterConfirmationMode
methods.description: Configures the channel for publisher confirms and clears existing listeners before adding new confirm and return listeners.

methods.name: sendFailedFuture
methods.description: Creates a failed CompletableFuture with an associated error message.

methods.name: sendFailed
methods.description: Constructs a MessageSendingFailedException with error details and relevant headers.
